product_specifics.name: character
product_specifics.description: Particular character, person, or entity that the item represents or is associated with. Sample values: Chewbacca , Spongebob .

product_specifics.name: closure
product_specifics.description: Type of fastener used to close your item. Sample values: Zipper , Button , Snap , Drawstring .

product_specifics.name: fabric_care_instructions
product_specifics.description: Specific care instructions for how the fabric of your item should be cleaned. Instructions are on the item label. Sample values: Dry Clean Only , Machine Washable , Do Not Iron , Hand Wash . To provide multiple values using a single feed fabric_care_instructions field, the acceptable input format is 'Dry Clean Only', 'Machine Washable', 'Do Not Iron', 'Hand Wash' .

product_specifics.name: is_costume
product_specifics.description: Indicates if the item is intended to be worn as a costume. Sample values: Yes , No .

product_specifics.name: size_system
product_specifics.description: Size system used by your item, usually corresponds to country. Samples values: US , UK , EU , DE , FR , JP , CN , IT , BR , MEX , AU .

product_specifics.name: sport
product_specifics.description: Particular sport or activity for which your item is intended. Multiple values accepted. Sample values: Tennis , Soccer , Hiking , Running , Yoga , Basketball . To provide multiple values using a single feed occasion field, the acceptable input format is 'Tennis', 'Soccer', 'Hiking', 'Running', 'Yoga', 'Basketball' .

product_specifics.name: sports_league
product_specifics.description: Particular sports league that your item represents or is associated with. Sample values: NFL , NBA , NASCAR .

product_specifics.name: sports_team
product_specifics.description: Particular sports team that your item represents or is associated with. Sample values: Golden State Warriors , San Francisco Giants .

product_specifics.name: standard_features
product_specifics.description: Standard features related to the item. Sample values: Waterproof , Water Resistant . To provide multiple values using a single feed standard_features field, the acceptable input format is 'Waterproof', Water Resistant' . Note : The value inputs listed for standard_features are not sample values. They are the only inputs that are accepted.

product_specifics.name: sunglasses_lens_color
product_specifics.description: Color of sunglasses lenses. Sample values: Beige , Black , Blue , Bronze , Brown , Gold , Gray , Green , Multi-Color , Orange , Pink , Purple , Red , Silver , White , Yellow .

product_specifics.name: sunglasses_lens_technology
product_specifics.description: Technology or treatment of sunglass lenses. Multiple values accepted. Sample values: Anti-Reflective , Gradient , Polarized , Photochromatic . To provide multiple values using a single feed sunglasses_lens_technology field, the acceptable input format is 'Anti-Reflective', 'Gradient', 'Polarized', 'Photochromatic' .

product_specifics.name: sunglasses_width
product_specifics.description: Width of the sunglasses frame. Sample values: Narrow , Medium , Wide .

product_specifics.name: theme
product_specifics.description: Particular subject, theme, or idea that your item represents or is associated with. Sample values: Space , Super Heroes , Automobiles .

product_specifics.name: tie_width
product_specifics.description: Width of tie. Sample values: Classic , Skinny , Wide .
